name: Ajo blanco
assumptions: Yield estimated from typical ajo blanco recipes (4 small starter servings) and total volume of ~750-800 ml soup after blending soaked bread, almonds, 700 ml water, oil, garlic and vinegar.
Preparation minutes summed from explicit instruction times (10 min soak + negligible blending + 60 min chilling) plus ~10 min estimated active prep (measuring, adding ingredients).
White bread classified as containing wheat (gluten).
Almonds classified as tree nuts; no peanuts or other tree nuts listed.
No milk, eggs, fish, shellfish, soy or sesame ingredients listed or implied.
Red wine vinegar, garlic, olive oil and water introduce no allergens or diet conflicts.
All ingredients compatible with vegetarian, vegan, pescatarian and dairy-free patterns; gluten-free incompatible due to bread.
instructions:
step 1
Tip the bread into a bowl and pour over 350ml water. Leave to soak for 10 mins.

step 2
Blend the ingredients together with 350ml water and 1 tsp salt.

step 3
Let the soup cool in the fridge for 1 hr or so, then serve with a drizzle of oil and some black pepper.

ingredients.name: White bread
ingredients.assumptions: Standard white bread, as-is weight (soaked later but base weight used).

ingredients.name: Almonds
ingredients.assumptions: Blanched or skin-on almonds typical for ajo blanco; raw weight.

ingredients.name: Extra Virgin Olive Oil
ingredients.assumptions: Extra virgin olive oil density ≈0.92 g/ml; entire 50 ml used in the blended soup.

ingredients.name: Garlic Clove
ingredients.assumptions: 1 average garlic clove ≈3 g peeled; raw weight.

ingredients.name: Red Wine Vinegar
ingredients.assumptions: 1.5 tbsp red wine vinegar ≈22.5 ml, density ≈1.01 g/ml; entire amount blended.
